lyrics:
[FORM — establish the musical world]
[Arrangement: banjo, fiddle, mandolin, stomps, and body percussion]
[Production: pristine modern close-mic clarity]
[Rhythm establishes: stuttering stop-start punk rhythm with hard silences]
[Vocal behavior establishes: call-and-response between soloist and ensemble]
Subject: Rainbow-colored prismatic math, p-adic numbers, polyphonic, multi-tonal, multi-octave, hypersonic, other fun words, LOL.   Glittercore, weirdcore, happycore, shinycore, mathcore, fractalcore.   Fractals, p-adic numbers, quasi-crystals, Linea, morphogenesis.Neon happy rainbow color palette.
The first pass is deliberately legible. The listener is given a stable specimen before any mutation begins.
RECALL MOLD controls memory.
Nothing else is permitted to steal that jurisdiction.
[Anchor appears: three compact notes or syllables, clean and memorable.]
Record the anchor exactly. It will return after the system damages everything around it.

[DESTABILIZE — separate jurisdictions begin negotiating]
[Harmony changes according to: diatonic sweetness repeatedly interrupted by non-diatonic clusters]
[Melody refuses to imitate harmony and follows: fast scat-like contour with clipped consonant attacks]
[Rhythm remains governed by: stuttering stop-start punk rhythm with hard silences]
The song does not blend these instructions into one vague style. Each rule keeps its own job.
When harmony leans toward release, melody may refuse it. When rhythm accelerates internally, the vocal line may stretch a vowel across the pressure.
[COSMIC CLERK enters through narration]
Treats ontological collapse and universe errors as routine clerical backlog.
[PROPERTY THIEF enters through representation]
Steals an intrinsic physical/conceptual property and gives it to another.
[HOLE GUY enters through information loss]
Total excision of a fundamental primitive; the vacuum dictates behavior.
[Anchor returns unchanged for one bar.]
That unchanged return makes the surrounding deformation measurable.

[VOCAL ENGINE — use the mouth as part of the arrangement]
[Primary vocal technique: call-and-response between soloist and ensemble]
[Hard consonants become transient attacks: tk, kk, pt, dr.]
[Nasals become resonance: mm, nn, ng.]
[Open vowels become sustained melody: aa, oh, ee.]
[Rolled consonants accelerate agitation: rrr-ra, trrra.]
[Dense syllables compress time: kratak-tikka-brradan.]
[Long vowels stretch the same clock: aaaaaa—oooooo.]
The nonsense is not decorative. Its phonetics physically reinforce the selected rhythmic and melodic systems.
The singer explains the change while also enacting it: consonants shorten, vowels lengthen, and the line becomes its own instrumentation.

[FRACTURE — incompatible temporal scales coexist]
[Keep the main pulse recognizable.]
[Compress percussion activity into a short dense burst.]
[Stretch one vocal phrase across several bars.]
[Move harmonic tension slowly while melodic ornament moves quickly.]
The subject remains Rainbow-colored prismatic math, p-adic numbers, polyphonic, multi-tonal, multi-octave, hypersonic, other fun words, LOL.   Glittercore, weirdcore, happycore, shinycore, mathcore, fractalcore.   Fractals, p-adic numbers, quasi-crystals, Linea, morphogenesis.Neon happy rainbow color palette, but the method of describing it becomes unstable.
A statement begins as dry explanation and ends as phonetic mechanics.
A repeated phrase loses one ordinary word and gains one operational sound.
[Anchor attempts to return, but one interval or syllable has been altered.]
The system recognizes the anchor anyway. That recognition is now doing structural work.

[COLLAPSE — remove support instead of merely getting louder]
[Drop one entire jurisdiction for a short interval: harmony vanishes while rhythm and voice continue.]
[Then reverse it: rhythm thins to silence while harmony and sustained voice remain.]
The composition discovers which relationships were load-bearing.
RECALL MOLD remains active even when instrumentation changes.
The Little Guy rule is therefore heard as a causal law, not a costume.
[Performance attitude intensifies: sweetly earnest delivery against structurally hostile accompaniment]
The musicians commit harder to the contradiction instead of smoothing it out.
[Brief silence.]
The silence is counted as an event, not an absence.

[ANCHOR RETURNS — recognizable, damaged, useful]
[Return the original three-note or three-syllable figure.]
[Preserve its contour.]
[Change exactly one property inherited from the fracture.]
The anchor now proves that identity can survive mutation without staying pristine.
The singer names what changed in plain language.
Then the ensemble demonstrates it again without explanation.
[Call and response between explanation and enactment.]
One voice states the rule. Another voice performs the consequence. The instruments answer with the same relationship in their own jurisdiction.

[REFORM STRANGER — rebuild from the scar rather than resetting]

Its sound world uses minimalist repetition and phase process, with stuttering stop-start punk rhythm with hard silences controlling pulse and call-and-response between soloist and ensemble controlling the mouth as an instrument.
